name: Emiya Konga
desc:
Emiya Konga was an infamous thief, who a wore a dark coat. Konga was the master of an artform known as the Slider Style, which was utilized for a variety of mischief.

They possessed a ring but eventually lost it.
additional_info: -   This character, as well as their great grandson [Konga The Third](entity:konga_the_third), Konga's Clutch Ring and Konga's Parka, is primarily a reference to bcongeboy5, a tester during _Deepwoken'_s development who was notorious for spamming sliding movements and attacks.
